interpretation: All PASS_SYNCED statuses have identical picture/audio source-time origins. PASS_SYNCED_CROSSFADE_EDGE means only that a clip's own aligned audio ends or begins 1-3 frames inside one picture edge while adjacent H3-native audio covers those frames; it is not a synchronization failure. The count of three applies only to this narrow picture-coverage condition. It is not a count of the edit's crossfades or L/J overlaps: many aligned native-audio segments intentionally continue for seconds beyond their picture cuts or across multiple picture segments.
